$comment: Proposal v1 (21.10.2026): rows that differ from mod 0.13.0. accGain, sightReact and fireDelay are not in the mod yet. accGain = share x (1 - acc): the bot's own accuracy changes its aim error by up to +-16 % (Novice) to +-32 % (Inhuman). Godlike gets a negative base accuracy: its internal skill 3 alone is a big step.
